mapper.delete: /* SvcReqItemMapper.deleteBySvcReqSn */ DELETE FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn}
mapper.select: /* SvcReqItemMapper.findPublicItemContentsBySvcReqSn */ SELECT SVC_REQ_ITM_CN FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM WHERE SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND SVC_REQ_ITM_STRUCT_YN = 'Y' AND SVC_REQ_ITM_PUBLIC_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SVC_REQ_ITM_SORT_NO ASC

/* SvcReqItemMapper.findStructuredAnswersBySvcReqSn */ SELECT S.SVC_REQ_STEP_KEY AS stepKey, F.SVC_REQ_FIELD_KEY AS fieldKey, SO.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_VAL AS stepOptionValue, SO.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_LABEL AS stepOptionLabel, FO.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_VAL AS fieldOptionValue, FO.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_LABEL AS fieldOptionLabel, I.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN AS value, I.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_ENC AS encryptedValue, I.SVC_REQ_ITM_CN AS snapshot FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM I JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_DEF S ON S.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND S.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN = I.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF F ON F.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND F.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_DEF SO ON SO.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND SO.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN = I.SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN LEFT JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_DEF FO ON FO.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN AND FO.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN = I.SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN WHERE I.SVC_REQ_SN = #{svcReqSn} AND I.SVC_REQ_ITM_STRUCT_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY I.SVC_REQ_ITM_SORT_NO ASC
mapper.insert:
/* SvcReqItemMapper.insertAll */ INSERT INTO SVC_REQ_ITEM (SVC_REQ_SN, SVC_REQ_FORM_TMPL_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN, SVC_REQ_STEP_OPT_SN, SVC_REQ_FIELD_OPT_SN, SVC_REQ_ITM_CN, SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_ENC, SVC_REQ_ITM_STRUCT_YN, SVC_REQ_ITM_PUBLIC_YN, SVC_REQ_ITM_SORT_NO) VALUES
(#{it.svcReqSn}, #{it.formTemplateSn}, #{it.stepSn}, #{it.fieldSn}, #{it.stepOptionSn}, #{it.fieldOptionSn}, #{it.svcReqItmCn}, #{it.value}, #{it.encryptedValue}, COALESCE(#{it.structuredYn}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{it.publicYn}, 'N'), #{it.svcReqItmSortNo})
